title: Differentiating Through Dual Prices: End-to-End Policy Learning Under Capacity Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.04669v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many social services assign scarce resources, such as housing assistance or hospital interventions, to people who arrive one at a time. Each arrival must receive a decision immediately, and the long-run usage of every resource must stay within its capacity. We study how to learn such a policy from logged observational data. Recent work (Tang et al., 2024) proposes a decision-blind pipeline that fits one outcome model per treatment by regression, prices each capacitated resource from those models, and assigns each arrival the treatment with the largest predicted outcome minus price. We instead train the outcome models end-to-end, differentiating an off-policy estimate of the deployed policy's value through the dual prices themselves. We study two formulations: an exact nonconvex one, and a convex relaxation whose optimum always satisfies the capacity constraints in expectation and whose suboptimality can be explicitly bounded. translated_title: 通过对偶价格进行微分：容量约束下的端到端策略学习
translated_abstract: 许多社会服务将稀缺资源（如住房援助或医疗干预）分配给逐一到达的求助者。每位到达者必须立即获得分配决策，且每项资源的长期使用量必须保持在其容量范围内。我们研究如何从记录的观测数据中学习这样的策略。最近的研究（Tang等人，2024）提出了一种决策无关的流程：通过回归为每种处理方式拟合一个结果模型，基于这些模型为每个有容量约束的资源定价，并为每位到达者分配预测结果减去价格后收益最大的处理方式。我们则转而端到端地训练结果模型，通过对偶价格本身对已部署策略价值的离策略估计进行反向传播求导。我们研究了两种形式化方法：一种是精确的非凸形式，另一种是凸松弛形式，后者的最优解在期望意义上始终满足容量约束，且其次优性可以被显式地界定。
tldr: 该论文提出通过对偶价格进行端到端微分来联合训练结果模型与分配策略，实现了容量约束下从观测数据中学习资源分配策略，并给出了具有可证明容量可行性和次优性界的凸松弛形式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes end-to-end training of outcome models by differentiating off-policy value estimates through dual prices, enabling capacity-constrained policy learning from observational data, with a convex relaxation that guarantees capacity feasibility in expectation and explicitly bounded suboptimality.
